title: Car Leasing Sales Advisor
description:
CAR LEASING SALES ADVISOR
MACCLESFIELD (office based only)
25, 000 - 26, 000pa doe + UNCAPPED COMMS

Mon to Fri 8.30am - 5.30pm

Our client is seeking a self motivated Car Leasing Sales Advisor with a solid proven background in sales - this role is telephone based and involves following up warm leads (no cold calling).

We want to hear from individuals who are truly focused on the ote they can earn - the average sales teams earnings are sitting around 70 - 80k, with top earners coming in around 100k. This is realistic and can be proven at interview to reassure you these figures are realistic and being achieved by the team.

Car Leasing Sales Advisor Duties
- Managing your own pipeline of customers, acting upon warm leads
- Building rapport with customers and listening to their needs and requirements
- Sourcing a product to suit their needs, making suggestions and offering alternatives that they may not have considered
-Keeping up to date with product knowledge and changes within the industry
- Ensuring you stay in contact with previous customers to assist them with renewals

Car Leasing Sales Advisor Requirements
- A solid background in sales, you must be confident speaking to customers over the telephone
- Experience in car sales or car leasing is essential
- You must live within a sensible commuting distance of Macclesfield - if you live outside of Macclesfield then own transport is needed due to location

To apply for the Car Leasing Sales Advisor role please send your Cv for a response back in 72 hours.

title: Outbound Sales Adviser
company: Work Lyf Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Work Lyf Group is currently recruiting for experienced Outbound Sales Advisors to join a thriving and fast-paced sales team based in Crewe. With the busy season approaching, we are looking for motivated and target-driven individuals who enjoy building customer relationships and achieving results.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive team, offering a competitive salary, uncapped commission, ongoing training, and genuine career development opportunities.

Salary

28,840 per annum + Uncapped Commission

Available Shifts

Monday to Friday (40 Hours)

Monday late shift 08:50am - 19:30pm

Tues,Wed,Thurs 08:50am - 17:20pm

Friday 08:50am - 15:20pm

or

Mon-Thurs 08:50am-19:30pm

The Role

As an Outbound Sales Advisor, you will be responsible for contacting existing and prospective customers, promoting products and services, generating sales opportunities, and delivering exceptional customer service.

Key responsibilities include:
- Making outbound sales calls to existing and potential customers
- Building and maintaining strong customer relationships
- Identifying customer needs and recommending suitable products and services
- Working towards individual and team sales targets
- Managing customer information and call activity through CRM systems
- Scheduling follow-up calls and maintaining an active sales pipeline
- Handling customer enquiries professionally and efficiently
- Participating in ongoing training, coaching, and development sessions
- Working collaboratively with colleagues to achieve team objectives

What We're Looking For

To be successful in this role, you must have:
- A minimum of 6 months' cold calling experience OR 12 months' experience within an outbound sales/contact centre environment
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills
- A confident and professional telephone manner
- Strong customer service skills
- The ability to work towards targets and KPIs
- Good IT skills, including experience using CRM systems
- A positive attitude and strong team-working ethic

Benefits
- Competitive salary of 28,840
- Uncapped commission structure
- Full training and ongoing coaching
- Supportive and friendly team environment
- Career progression opportunities
- Company benefits package

If you're a motivated sales professional looking to join a growing business and maximise your earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Account Manager
description:
About the Organisation

With over 45 years of valve technology innovations, we are a global leader in the design, manufacture, and supply of high-quality valves and valve systems, serving the oil and gas, petrochemical, and other critical sectors. As a profitable, privately owned, and fast-moving company, we have won recognised awards for Export, Manufacturing, and Growth-including the coveted Queens Award and more recently the Kings Award for Industry. We look for talented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment to help deliver our strategic objectives.

The Role & Opportunity

We are seeking a dynamic and commercially focused Internal Sales Engineer with a strong technical foundation and a passion for customer engagement and solution selling. Acting as a central point of contact for commercial and technical enquiries, you will play a key role in driving business growth, supporting customers from initial enquiry through to final order processing.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage incoming enquiries and prepare accurate commercial and technical quotations aligned to customer requirements.
- Provide technical guidance and commercial support to customers throughout the sales process.
- Process orders efficiently and maintain accurate CRM records of all opportunities and client interactions.
- Proactively develop key accounts to increase technical enquiries and overall sales volume.
- Review customer terms and ensure all order margins meet company profit expectations.
- Collaborate closely with the external sales team to share leads, market intelligence, and project opportunities.

What We Are Looking For
- Qualifications: A Mechanical Engineering qualification or equivalent practical engineering experience.
- Experience: Proven background in a technical sales, internal sales, or applications engineering role within an industrial environment.
- Industry Knowledge: Experience with valves, flow control systems, the oil and gas sector, or manufacturing is highly desirable.
- Skills: Strong communication abilities, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organisational skills.
- Systems: Proficiency with CRM systems and the Microsoft Office suite.

What's on Offer
- Base Salary: Competitive basic salary between 35,000 and 48,000 per annum.
- Bonus: Discretionary performance-related bonus scheme.
- Holidays: 31 days annual leave (including bank holidays), which increases with length of service.
- Pension: Company pension scheme with a 4% employer / 5% employee contribution.
- Healthcare: Medi-cash health plan.
- Development: Structured technical training and long-term career development opportunities within a well-established engineering business.
